subject.title: feat(gateway): include produced messageId on chat final/aborted events

question: Should Gateway terminal events expose the persisted transcript `messageId` as a stable client-facing deduplication reference, or should the product instead provide an opaque run-to-produced-message lookup?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but either choice establishes a different long-term external protocol boundary and migration obligation that tests alone cannot choose.

options.title: Adopt the transcript ID contract
options.body: Accept `messageId` as the stable optional terminal-event reference, retain the additive implementation, and treat future transcript-ID changes as Gateway compatibility work.

options.title: Use an opaque lookup contract
options.body: Ask for a narrow redesign that keeps transcript identifiers internal and exposes a stable lookup from run to produced message instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt the transcript ID contract
recommendation.body: Accept `messageId` as the stable optional terminal-event reference, retain the additive implementation, and treat future transcript-ID changes as Gateway compatibility work.

likelyOwner.reason: No more specific current-main Gateway protocol owner was established from the supplied history, so repository-level protocol direction needs this routing decision.
